evidence.text: The opened 刀-seal.svg description identifies its vector as a depiction of 刀 in Shuowen seal-script style and links to the original SVG and to Academia Sinica record 27.5200. Its description includes mixed provenance and rights wording, but the glyph is available under a stated CC0 dedication. The 到-seal.svg and supplied radical-file page opens failed. Followed the 刀-seal page to its exact Xiaoxuetang form record and official rights notice.

gaps: No 到 image is selected: the exact 到 seal description page and direct upload URL could not be verified, and the alternate bronze file’s description page and imageinfo lookup also failed. Search-result descriptions alone do not establish reusable direct-image provenance.

The verified 刀 seal-style redraw could illustrate the named phonetic component, but it cannot demonstrate the graphic development of 到. The 到-specific form chronology and the competing analyses remain unresolved as described in the dossier.

items.caption: Modern vector rendering of the Shuowen seal-style form of 刀, the phonetic element named in the usual analysis of 到.
items.alt: A modern vector redraw of the seal-style character 刀.
items.selection_reason: Shows the independently identified seal-style form of the phonetic component. It is not evidence for an ancient sound change or for the shape of 到 itself.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states CC0 1.0 for the file; its provenance notes a Xiaoxuetang source image and also includes Richard Sears permission wording. The selected component form is independently present in Xiaoxuetang query record 27.5200, whose official notice releases queried glyph images and attributes under CC0.

limitations.text: The character-specific 到 seal image could not be verified, so this component illustration must not be captioned as a historical form of the whole character 到.
